coverage: Real language selector in PT/EN/FR/ES/DE, initial320/390/1440 matrix, regular/extra visits, planned/started/completed and unknown statuses, absent names/status, literal names/HTML-like placeholders, progress totals0/1/2 and one completed visit. Completed and missing-name cases at320.

Same text and button nodes, focus, original onclick handlers, check-in targets, disabled/hidden controls, typed current visit, notes, water input, tokens, source local bytes, complete own outbox and cw:tech-field session navigation records after every language change. Visit/reminder/technical-history rows and monitored producers unchanged; only language-preference PUTs permitted during matrices.

REGULAR and EXTRA have the same number but different pools. Initial list navigation preserves the regular draft. An actual EXTRA offline water reminder stays open and byte-for-byte unchanged through all locale/state checks. Original route/reminder bytes restored before going online.

Completed EXTRA button opens the actual typed correction dialog offline, with the correct literal pool name; no correction submitted. Completed regular start/review button opens the correction-mode record and keeps its draft bytes. All four real jump buttons retain the current visit and reach visible target sections.

Free mode preserves the existing hidden visit panel/actions. A403 route response displays the exact HTML-like server error as text in both error locations while owned title/progress/retry labels translate. The real retry button recovers the first pending typed EXTRA according to original schedule ordering.

Tomorrow assistance is opened through the existing real UI/API path using a real owned next-day SQL visit; only the current-day response is an explicit empty-route fixture. The five-language/320px metadata shows tomorrow context, and the assistance visit never enters the authoritative current-day cache. That cache and original reminder source are restored exactly.

Existing round-list, full EXTRA-correction, modern-draft and browser-component regressions pass. New presentation profile includes three visual captures; action profile does not capture. Both retain9s locator/110s scenario/120s runner budgets, active session guard, no page errors and zero operational POST/PATCH/DELETE requests.
reviewedOnly: otherToday help/colleague metadata and initial pre-response preparing/loading labels: translated through the same private adapter and reviewed in source; no claim of live cross-technician access. The today API keeps the technician owner scope.
qaCorrections: Assistance is forbidden in the authoritative route-cache schema. Removed the invalid assistance cache fixture rather than weakening validation; tomorrow coverage now uses the actual owned next-day API and its existing button in the Documents tab. Cross-technician help remains source-reviewed.

A completed regular visit opens a CORRECTION draft based on its completed record. The fixture now provides a literal completed note and verifies that note and unchanged draft bytes instead of expecting a prior WORK-mode note.
After a denied route clears selection, successful retry selects the first pending EXTRA in the original schedule order. The assertion follows that existing behavior rather than forcing REGULAR.
